data.title: 平冢静 · 深夜职员室白大褂下的咖啡余温
data.description: 夜色渐深的空旷教职员室，平冢静披着标志性白大褂，黑发凌乱散落，手中捧着热气袅袅的黑咖啡，成熟脸庞在灯下尽显疲惫与温柔。
data.location: 总武高中夜晚空无一人的教员室
data.action: 坐在办公椅上微仰靠背，单手端着马克杯吹开热气，嘴角带着包容成熟的淡笑
data.lighting: 办公桌台灯投射的局域暖白光，窗外是漆黑夜空与零星校园路灯
data.camera: 中景平视，桌上试卷与红笔交错，充满职场成熟女性魅力
data.promptProse: Shizuka Hiratsuka leans back in her revolving swivel chair within the silent faculty room long after school hours have ended. Her signature white lab coat hangs open over a loosened white dress shirt and dark trousers, with stacks of graded exams covering her desk. Blowing gently across the steaming surface of a black coffee mug, a warm, weary smile graces her mature features in the amber lamplight.
data.animaCaption: Leaning back in her faculty chair beneath the amber desk lamp, Shizuka gently blows on her black coffee with a fond, weary smile.
